name: emush-desktop
description: Desktop client for eMush, ready for Steam distribution.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.shell.json && esbuild src/shell/main.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=chrome130 --outfile=dist/shell/shell.js --log-level=warning && esbuild src/mini/main.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=chrome130 --outfile=dist/mini/mini.js --log-level=warning && node scripts/copy-static.mjs
